paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Wait-k Policy
model_annotation: The figure illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency policies. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL)”, ranges from 0 to 8 with tick labels displayed every 2 units on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU”, ranges from 20 to 30 with tick labels displayed every 2 units on a linear scale. Four lines are plotted, each representing a different consistency policy as indicated in the legend. A blue dashed line with circle markers represents “Consistency-CE”, starting at approximately (0, 20) and ending at approximately (8, 27). A light orange dashed line with triangle markers represents “Consistency-Bi +sampling”, starting at approximately (0, 24) and ending at approximately (8, 29). A green dashed line with square markers represents “Consistency-Bi +beam”, starting at approximately (0, 25) and ending at approximately (8, 29). Finally, a gray dashed line with diamond markers represents a baseline which begins at approximately (0, 24) and ascends to approximately (8, 28). The legend is located in the lower right corner of the figure and maps line style and marker shape to each policy. Horizontal grid lines are present, spanning the entire plot area.
